lines.trans: How does the internship feel?
It feels great, and I also want to thank Professor Fang for the recommendation.
Professor, I feel slightly disappointed.
Do not get too anxious; the hiring competition is very fierce.
The chance of staying on at the end is really not very high.
The two of you need to be mentally prepared.
I also have an appointment with someone; you two head back first.
No problem, Professor.
You do not need to be too pessimistic either; you can try Yunhai Television.
